children.text: Chapter 1
atha paśukāmaḥ sāyaṃ paśuṣu sameteṣv agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ||
children.translated_text: Now one who desires cattle should offer the agnihotra in the evening when the cattle have gathered together.

children.text: brahma vā agnihotram ||
children.translated_text: The agnihotra is indeed <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: brahmaṇaivaitat paśūn parigṛhṇāti ||
children.translated_text: By <s>brahman</s> itself he thereby encloses the cattle.

children.text: avisṛṣṭeṣu prātar ||
children.translated_text: In the morning, when they have not been let out.

children.text: brahma vā agnihotram ||
children.translated_text: The agnihotra is indeed <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: brahmaṇaivaitat paśūn parigṛhṇāti ||
children.translated_text: By <s>brahman</s> itself he thereby encloses the cattle.

children.text: sa etān brahmaṇobhayataḥ paśūn parigṛhṇīte ||
children.translated_text: Thus on both sides he encloses these cattle with <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: ava paśūn runddhe ||
children.translated_text: He pens in the cattle.

children.text: bahupaśur bhavati ||
children.translated_text: He becomes rich in cattle.

children.text: atha svargakāmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Now, one who desires heaven:

children.text: dvau samudrāvacaryau vitatau mahāntāvāvarīvartete patheva padāviti ||
children.translated_text: "Two vast, great oceans, to be traversed, keep turning like two paths, like two footprints."

children.text: dvau haiva samudrāv acaryāv ahaś caiva rātriś ca ||
children.translated_text: The two oceans to be traversed are indeed just day and night.

children.text: te ye naktaṃ juhvati rātrim eva te samudraṃ praviśanti ||
children.translated_text: Those who offer at night enter night itself as the ocean.

children.text: atha ya udite juhvaty ahar eva te samudraṃ praviśanti ||
children.translated_text: But those who offer when the sun has risen enter day itself as the ocean.

children.text: tayor vā etayor atyayanam asti yathā vaiṣacaṃ vā syāt setor vā saṃkramaṇam astamite purā tamisrāyai suvyuṣṭāyāṃ purodayāt ||
children.translated_text: For these two there is a crossing, as there might be a ford, or the crossing of a bridge: after sunset, before darkness, and at good dawn before sunrise.

children.text: Chapter 2
atho haitau śyāmaśabalāv eva yad ahorātre ||
children.translated_text: Moreover these two, day and night, are just the dark one and the dappled one.

children.text: ahar vai śabalo rātriś śyāmas ||
children.translated_text: Day is the dappled one, night the dark one.

children.text: te ye naktaṃ juhvati rātrim eva te śyāmaṃ praviśanti ||
children.translated_text: Those who offer at night enter the dark one, night itself.

children.text: atha ya udite juhvaty ahar eva te śabalaṃ praviśanti ||
children.translated_text: But those who offer when the sun has risen enter the dappled one, day itself.

children.text: tayor etad evātyayanam astamite purā tamisrāyai suvyuṣṭāyāṃ purodayāt ||
children.translated_text: For these two this alone is the crossing: after sunset, before darkness, and at good dawn before sunrise.

children.text: atho haiṣu savitaiva dyumnas ||
children.translated_text: Moreover among them <s>Savitṛ</s> himself is brightness.

children.text: savitā vai prajāpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Savitṛ</s> is indeed <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: prajāpatir viśve devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> is the All-gods.

children.text: prajāpatāv evāsya tad viśveṣu deveṣu hutaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: Thus his oblation is offered in <s>Prajāpati</s>, among the All-gods.

children.text: tad etat prājāpatyaṃ yad agnihotram ||
children.translated_text: That agnihotra is therefore connected with <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: atha yad etat prātaḥ prabhāty etasmin vai dyumne prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ prajanayāṃ cakāra ||
children.translated_text: And this light which shines forth in the morning: in this brightness <s>Prajāpati</s> generated creatures.

children.text: savitā vai prajāpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Savitṛ</s> is indeed <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: prajāpatir viśve devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> is the All-gods.

children.text: prajāpatāv evāsya tad viśveṣu deveṣu hutaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: Thus his oblation is offered in <s>Prajāpati</s>, among the All-gods.

children.text: tad etad vaiśvadevaṃ yad agnihotram ||
children.translated_text: That agnihotra is therefore connected with the All-gods.

children.text: atho haitad ahorātre evammukhaṃ saṃdhatto ||
children.translated_text: Moreover in this way he joins day and night mouth to mouth.

children.text: annaṃ vā agnihotram ||
children.translated_text: The agnihotra is indeed food.

children.text: annādyam evaitad ahorātrayor mukhato 'pidadhāti ||
children.translated_text: He thereby places food to be eaten at the mouths of day and night.

children.text: evam eva punaḥ prātas saṃdhatto ||
children.translated_text: In just the same way he joins them again in the morning.

children.text: annaṃ vā agnihotram ||
children.translated_text: The agnihotra is indeed food.

children.text: annādyam evaitad ahorātrayor mukhato 'pidhāyaitau punarmṛtyū atimucyate yad ahorātre ||
children.translated_text: Having placed food to be eaten at the mouths of day and night, he escapes again beyond these two deaths, namely day and night.

children.text: Chapter 3
asau vā ādityo 'staṃ yan ṣoḍhā vimrocati ||
children.translated_text: That sun, when it sets, withdraws in six ways.

children.text: vyamrucad iti ha sma vā etaṃ pūrve purāṇina ācakṣate ||
children.translated_text: In former times, the men of old used to call this "it has withdrawn apart."

children.text: athaitarhi nyamrucad iti ||
children.translated_text: But now they call it "it has gone down."

children.text: sa vā eṣo 'staṃ yan brāhmaṇam eva śraddhayā praviśati payasā paśūṃs tejasāgnim ūrjauṣadhī rasenāpas svadhayā vanaspatīn ||
children.translated_text: When it sets, it enters the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> with faith, the cattle with milk, the fire with heat, the plants with nourishment, the waters with sap, and the forest-trees with ancestral sustenance.

children.text: sa yad brāhmaṇo 'gnihotrapātrāṇi nirṇenekti yat pariceṣṭati yayaivainaṃ śraddhayā praviṣṭo bhavati tām evāsmiṃs tat saṃbharati ||
children.translated_text: When the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> rinses the agnihotra vessels, and when he moves about them, with that very faith by which the sun has entered him, he gathers it into this rite.

children.text: atha yat payo duhanti yena payasā paśūn praviṣṭo bhavati tad evāsmiṃs tat saṃbharati ||
children.translated_text: And when they milk the milk, with that very milk by which the sun has entered the cattle, he gathers it into this rite.

children.text: atha yad aṅgārān nirūhati yena tejasāgniṃ praviṣṭo bhavati tad evāsmiṃs tat saṃbharati ||
children.translated_text: And when he draws out the embers, with that very heat by which the sun has entered the fire, he gathers it into this rite.

children.text: atha yat tṛṇenāvadyotayati yayorjauṣadhīḥ praviṣṭo bhavati tām evāsmiṃs tat saṃbharati ||
children.translated_text: And when he lights it with grass, with that very nourishment by which the sun has entered the plants, he gathers it into this rite.

children.text: atha yad apaḥ pratyānayati yena rasenāpaḥ praviṣṭo bhavati tam evāsmiṃs tat saṃbharati ||
children.translated_text: And when he brings back the waters, with that very sap by which the sun has entered the waters, he gathers it into this rite.

children.text: atha yat samidham abhyādadhāti yayā svadhayā vanaspatīn praviṣṭo bhavati tām evāsmiṃstat saṃbharati ||
children.translated_text: And when he lays on the kindling-stick, with that very ancestral sustenance by which the sun has entered the forest-trees, he gathers it into this rite.

children.text: Chapter 4
atha ha smāha nagarī jānaśruteyo 'sau vā ādityo 'staṃ yann agnim eva yoniṃ praviśatīti ||
children.translated_text: Now <s>Nagarī Jānaśruteya</s> used to say, "That sun, when it sets, enters fire itself as its womb."

children.text: sa yad ete sāyamāhutī juhoty etasyaiva tad ādityasya pṛṣṭhe pratitiṣṭhati yathobhayapadī pratitiṣṭhet tādṛk tat ||
children.translated_text: When he offers these evening oblations, he thereby stands upon the back of that very sun, as one would stand with both feet; such is the rite.

children.text: atha yad ete prātarāhutī juhoty utthāpayatyevainaṃ tābhyām ||
children.translated_text: And when he offers these morning oblations, by them he makes the sun rise.

children.text: sa yathā hastī hastyāsanam uparyāsīnam ādāyottiṣṭhed evam evaiṣā devataitad vidvāṃsaṃ juhvatam ādāyodeti ||
children.translated_text: As an elephant might rise, taking up the man seated above on the elephant-seat, just so this deity rises taking up the knowing man who offers.

children.text: sainaṃ taṃ lokaṃ gamayati ya etasyai yataḥ paraṃ nāsti ||
children.translated_text: She leads him to that world of hers beyond which there is nothing higher.

children.text: sa yat kiṃ ca parācīnam ādityāt tad amṛtaṃ tad abhijayati ||
children.translated_text: Whatever is beyond the sun is immortal; that he conquers.

children.text: atha yad arvācīnam ādityād ahorātre tad upamathnīto yathā reṣmopamathnīyād evam ||
children.translated_text: But what is on this side of the sun, day and night, he crushes, just as one might crush a cord.

children.text: bahavo ha vā ādityāt parāñco lokāḥ ||
children.translated_text: There are indeed many worlds beyond the sun.

children.text: te 'sya sarva āptā bhavanti te jitāḥ ||
children.translated_text: All of them are obtained by him; they are conquered.

children.text: teṣvasya sarveṣu kāmacāro bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoti ||
children.translated_text: In all of them he has freedom to move at will, who, knowing thus, offers the agnihotra.

children.text: Chapter 5
devā vai mṛtyunā samayatanta ||
children.translated_text: The gods once contended with death.

children.text: sa yo ha sa mṛtyur agnir eva sa ||
children.translated_text: That death which there was is fire itself.

children.text: te 'bruvann etemaṃ jigīṣāmeti ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Come, let us conquer him."

children.text: te 'bruvann ājyāhutiṃ juhavāma tayainaṃ jigīṣāmeti ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Let us offer an oblation of ghee; with it let us conquer him."

children.text: tatheti ||
children.translated_text: "So be it," they said.

children.text: ta ājyāhutim ajuhavuḥ ||
children.translated_text: They offered an oblation of ghee.

children.text: tām annam akuruta tāṃ pratyudadīpyata ||
children.translated_text: He made it food, and he blazed up against it.

children.text: tasmād yatrājyāhutiṃ juhvati pratyuddīpyata eva ||
children.translated_text: Therefore wherever they offer an oblation of ghee, it blazes up against it.

children.text: te 'bruvan paśvāhutiṃ juhavāma tayainaṃ jigīṣāmeti ||
children.translated_text: They said, "Let us offer an animal-oblation; with it let us conquer him."

children.text: tatheti ||
children.translated_text: "So be it," they said.

children.text: te paśum ālabhya medas samavadāya paśvāhutim ajuhavuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Having seized the animal, they cut out the fat and offered the animal-offering.

children.text: tām annam akuruta tāṃ pratyudadīpyata ||
children.translated_text: He made that into food; it flared up against it.

children.text: tasmād yatra paśvāhutiṃ juhvati pratyuddīpyata eva ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, wherever they offer an animal-offering, it indeed flares back up.

children.text: te 'bruvan kṣīrāhutiṃ juhavāma tayainaṃ jigīṣāmeti ||
children.translated_text: They said, 'Let us offer a milk-offering; with it we shall conquer him.'

children.text: tatheti ||
children.translated_text: 'So be it,' they said.

children.text: te kṣīrāhutim ajuhavuḥ ||
children.translated_text: They offered the milk-offering.

children.text: tayainam ajayan ||
children.translated_text: With it they conquered him.

children.text: tasmād yatra kṣīrāhutiṃ juhvaty aṅgārā eva bhavanti ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, wherever they offer a milk-offering, there are only embers.

children.text: te 'bruvann ajeṣma vā enam annena hantānapajayyaṃ jigīṣāmeti ||
children.translated_text: They said, 'We have conquered him with food; come, let us conquer him as one not to be defeated.'

children.text: Chapter 6
te 'bruvan somāhutiṃ juhavāma tayainaṃ jigīṣāmeti ||
children.translated_text: They said, 'Let us offer a soma-offering; with it we shall conquer him.'

children.text: tatheti ||
children.translated_text: 'So be it,' they said.

children.text: te somenāyajanta ||
children.translated_text: They sacrificed with soma.

children.text: te somāhutim ajuhavuḥ ||
children.translated_text: They offered the soma-offering.

children.text: tayainaṃ prājayan ||
children.translated_text: With it they conquered him completely.

children.text: tasmād yatra somāhutiṃ juhvaty aṅgārā eva bhavanti ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, wherever they offer a soma-offering, there are only embers.

children.text: sa ya evaṃ vidvān ājyāhutiṃ ca paśvāhutiṃ ca juhoti priyam evāsya tena dhāmopagacchati ||
children.translated_text: One who, knowing thus, offers both the ghee-offering and the animal-offering thereby approaches his own dear abode.

children.text: atha yat kṣīrāhutiṃ juhoti jayaty evainaṃ tena ||
children.translated_text: And when he offers the milk-offering, by that he indeed conquers him.

children.text: atha yat somāhutiṃ juhoti yathā jitvā prajayet tādṛk tat ||
children.translated_text: And when he offers the soma-offering, that is as when, after conquering, one conquers completely.

children.text: sa etau punarmṛtyū atimucyate yad ahorātre ||
children.translated_text: He is released beyond these two repeated deaths, namely day and night.

children.text: Chapter 7
āruṇir vājasaneyo prakur vārṣṇaḥ priyo jānaśruteyo buḍila āśvatarāśvir vaiyāghrapadya ity ete ha pañca mahābrahmā āsuḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Āruṇi Vājasaneya</s>, <s>Prakur Vārṣṇa</s>, <s>Priya Jānaśruteya</s>, <s>Buḍila Āśvatarāśvi</s>, and <s>Vaiyāghrapadya</s>: these five were great brahmans.

children.text: te hocur janako vā ayaṃ vaideho 'gnihotre 'nuśiṣṭaḥ sa no 'tivadann iva manyata eta tam agnihotre kathāṃ vādayiṣyāma iti ||
children.translated_text: They said, '<s>Janaka Vaideha</s> here has been instructed in the Agnihotra, and he seems to think that he surpasses us. Come, we shall make him speak in discussion about the Agnihotra.'

children.text: te hājagmuḥ ||
children.translated_text: They came there.

children.text: te ha brahmacāriṇam ūcuḥ pra ṇo brūhīti ||
children.translated_text: They said to the brahmacārin, 'Announce us.'

children.text: tān ha provāca ||
children.translated_text: He announced them.

children.text: tebhyo ha proktebhyaḥ pṛthag āsanāni pṛthag udakāni pṛthaṅ madhuparkān pṛthag āvasathān pṛthak pañcabhyaḥ pañcāpacitīś cakāra ||
children.translated_text: After they had been announced to him, he prepared separate seats, separate waters, separate honey-mixtures, separate lodgings, and separate honors, five for the five of them.

children.text: atha haiṣāṃ sabhāga āvavrājoptvā keśaśmaśrūṇi nakhān nikṛtyājyābhyajya daṇḍopānahaṃ bibhrat ||
children.translated_text: Then he entered their assembly portion, having shaved his hair and beard, cut his nails, anointed himself with ghee, and carrying a staff and sandals.

children.text: tān hovāca brāhmaṇāḥ kathā bhagavanto no 'nusaṃvādayatheti ||
children.translated_text: He said to them, 'Brahmans, in what discussion do your reverences make us take part?'

children.text: ati no 'vādīr iti hocuḥ ||
children.translated_text: 'You have surpassed us,' they said.

children.text: atha hainān pūrvaḥ papraccha brāhmaṇāḥ kathā bhagavanto yūyam agnihotraṃ juhutheti ||
children.translated_text: Then the first of them questioned them: 'Brahmans, how do your reverences offer the Agnihotra?'

children.text: ati vai no 'vādīr iti hocur yo no bhūyasaḥ sataḥ pūrvo 'prākṣīr gautama pratibrūhīti ||
children.translated_text: 'You have indeed surpassed us,' they said, 'for, though we are the greater number, you questioned us first. <s>Gautama</s>, answer.'

children.text: Chapter 8
sa hovāca yaśa ity eva samrāḍ aham agnihotraṃ juhomi tasmād ahaṃ yaśo 'smi yaśo vāva me prajāyām antato bhaviteti ||
children.translated_text: He said, 'O emperor, I offer the Agnihotra simply as fame. Therefore I am fame; indeed fame will finally arise in my offspring.'

children.text: taṃ hovāca gautama kiṃ yaśa iti ||
children.translated_text: He said to him, '<s>Gautama</s>, what is fame?'

children.text: agnim upadiśann uvācedaṃ yaśa ity ado yaśa ity ādityaṃ so 'ham ado yaśo 'smin yaśasi sāyaṃ juhomīdaṃ yaśo 'muṣmin yaśasi prātar juhomyetāveva mā tad gamayiṣyato yatra sarve kāmā etau me punarmṛtyum apajeṣyata iti ||
children.translated_text: Pointing to the fire he said, 'This is fame,' and pointing to the sun, 'That is fame. I am that fame; in this fame I offer in the evening, and this fame I offer in that fame in the morning. These two will bring me to where all desires are; these two will conquer repeated death for me.'

children.text: suhutaṃ devān rādhayānīti ha praśaśaṃsa ||
children.translated_text: 'Well offered; may I satisfy the gods,' he praised.

children.text: atha hāparaṃ papraccha kathā bhagavas tvam agnihotraṃ juhoṣīti ||
children.translated_text: Then he questioned another: 'How, reverend sir, do you offer the Agnihotra?'

children.text: sa hovāca vājasaneyaḥ satyam ity eva samrāḍ aham agnihotraṃ juhomi tasmād ahaṃ satyam asmi tasmān mama satyam iva vadataḥ prakāśa iti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vājasaneya</s> said, 'O emperor, I offer the Agnihotra simply as truth. Therefore I am truth; therefore there is a brightness, as it were, when I speak truth.'

children.text: taṃ hovāca yājñavalkyaḥ kiṃ satyam iti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Yājñavalkya</s> said to him, 'What is truth?'

children.text: agnim upadiśann uvācedaṃ satyam ity adaḥ satyam ity ādityaṃ so 'ham adaḥ satyam asmin satye sāyaṃ juhomīdaṃ satyam amuṣmin satye prātar juhomyetāveva mā tad gamayiṣyato yatra sarve kāmā etau me punarmṛtyum apajeṣyata iti ||
children.translated_text: Pointing to the fire he said, 'This is truth,' and pointing to the sun, 'That is truth. I am that truth; in this truth I offer in the evening, and this truth I offer in that truth in the morning. These two will bring me to where all desires are; these two will conquer repeated death for me.'

children.text: suhutaṃ devān rādhayānīti haiva praśaśaṃsa ||
children.translated_text: In the same way he praised, 'Well offered; may I satisfy the gods.'

children.text: atha hāparaṃ papraccha kathā bhagavas tvam agnihotraṃ juhoṣīti ||
children.translated_text: Then he questioned another: 'How, reverend sir, do you offer the Agnihotra?'

children.text: Chapter 9

sa hovāca prakur vārṣṇo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vittānām ity eva samrāḍ aham agnihotraṃ juhomi tasmād ahaṃ bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vittānām asmi bhūyiṣṭhaṃ vāva me śreṣṭhaṃ vittānāṃ prajāyām antato bhaviteti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prakur Vārṣṇa</s> said, 'O emperor, I offer the Agnihotra simply as the greatest and best of possessions. Therefore I am the greatest and best of possessions; indeed the greatest and best of possessions will finally arise in my offspring.'

children.text: taṃ hovācāgniveśya kiṃ bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vittānām iti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Agniveśya</s> said to him, 'What is the greatest and best of possessions?'

children.text: agnim upadiśann uvācedaṃ bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vittānām ity ado bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vittānām ity ādityaṃ so 'ham ado bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vittānām asmin bhūyiṣṭhe śreṣṭhe vittānāṃ sāyaṃ juhomīdaṃ bhūyiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vittānām amuṣmin bhūyiṣṭhe śreṣṭhe vittānāṃ prātar juhomy etāv eva mā tad gamayiṣyato yatra sarve kāmā etau me punarmṛtyum apajeṣyata iti ||
children.translated_text: Pointing to the fire he said, 'This is the greatest and best of possessions,' and pointing to the sun, 'That is the greatest and best of possessions. I am that greatest and best of possessions; in this greatest and best of possessions I offer in the evening, and this greatest and best of possessions I offer in that greatest and best of possessions in the morning. These two will bring me to where all desires are; these two will conquer repeated death for me.'

children.text: suhutaṃ devān rādhayānīti haiva praśaśaṃsa ||
children.translated_text: In the same way he praised, 'Well offered; may I satisfy the gods.'

children.text: atha hāparaṃ papraccha kathā bhagavas tvam agnihotraṃ juhoṣīti ||
children.translated_text: Then he questioned another: 'How, reverend sir, do you offer the Agnihotra?'

children.text: sa hovāca priyo jānaśruteyas teja ity eva samrāḍ aham agnihotraṃ juhomi tasmād ahaṃ tejo 'smi tejo vāva me prajāyām antato bhaviteti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Priya Jānaśruteya</s> said, 'O emperor, I offer the Agnihotra simply as brilliance. Therefore I am brilliance; indeed brilliance will finally arise in my offspring.'

children.text: taṃ hovāca kāṇḍvīya kiṃ teja iti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kāṇḍvīya</s> said to him, 'What is brilliance?'

children.text: agnim upadiśann uvācedaṃ teja ity adas teja ity ādityaṃ so 'ham adas tejo 'smiṃs tejasi sāyaṃ juhomīdaṃ tejo 'muṣmiṃs tejasi prātar juhomy etāv eva mā tad gamayiṣyato yatra sarve kāmā etau me punarmṛtyum apajeṣyata iti ||
children.translated_text: Pointing to the fire, he said, "This is radiance"; pointing to the sun, "that is radiance. So I, being that radiance, offer in this radiance in the evening; I offer this radiance in that radiance in the morning. These two will lead me to the place where all desires are. These two will overcome renewed death for me."

children.text: suhutaṃ devān rādhayāni iti haiva praśaśaṃsa ||
children.translated_text: "It has been well offered; may I satisfy the gods," he praised it in just this way.

children.text: atha hāparaṃ papraccha kathā bhagavas tvam agnihotraṃ juhoṣīti ||
children.translated_text: Then another asked him, "How, reverend sir, do you offer the agnihotra?"

children.text: Chapter 10
sa hovāca buḍila āśvatarāśvir vaiyāghrapadyo 'rkāśvamedhāvity eva samrāḍ aham agnihotraṃ juhomy annaṃ hy etad devānāṃ yad arko 'śvo medho medhya iti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "O emperor, I, <s>Buḍila Āśvatarāśvi Vaiyāghrapadya</s>, offer the agnihotra as arka, aśva, medha, and medhya; for this is the food of the gods: arka, aśva, medha, and medhya."

children.text: taṃ hovāca vaiyāghrapadya ko 'rkaḥ ko 'śvo medho medhya iti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Vaiyāghrapadya</s>, he said to him, "What is arka? What is aśva, medha, and medhya?"

children.text: agnim upadiśann uvācāyam arka ityasāvaśvo medho medhya ity ādityaṃ so 'ham amum aśvaṃ medhaṃ medhyam asminn arke sāyaṃ juhomīmam arkam amuṣminn aśve medhe medhye prātar juhomy etāveva mā tad gamayiṣyato yatra sarve kāmā etau me punarmṛtyum apajeṣyata iti ||
children.translated_text: Pointing to the fire, he said, "This is arka"; pointing to the sun, "that is aśva, medha, and medhya. So I offer that horse, that medha and medhya, in this arka in the evening; I offer this arka in that horse, medha, and medhya in the morning. These two will lead me to the place where all desires are. These two will overcome renewed death for me."

children.text: suhutam iti ha praśasyovāca yo ha kila mahyam agnihotra itiṃ ca gatiṃ ca brūyāt tasmā ahaṃ varaṃ dadyām iti ||
children.translated_text: After praising it, saying, "It has been well offered," he said, "Whoever should tell me the iti and the gati of the agnihotra, to him I would give a boon."

children.text: te hocur na nvai vayam agnihotra itiṃ ca gatiṃ cānūcimahe tvam asmabhyam agnihotra itiṃ ca gatiṃ ca brūhi vayaṃ tubhyaṃ pṛthak pañca varān dadma iti ||
children.translated_text: They said, "We have not, indeed, learned the iti and the gati of the agnihotra. Tell us the iti and the gati of the agnihotra, and we will each give you five boons."

children.text: agnim upadiśann uvāceyam itir ity asau gatir ity ādityaṃ so 'ham amūṃ gatim asyām itau sāyaṃ juhomīmām itim amuṣyāṃ gatau prātar juhomy etāv eva mā tad gamayiṣyato yatra sarve kāmā etau me punarmṛtyum apajeṣyata iti ||
children.translated_text: Pointing to the fire, he said, "This is the iti"; pointing to the sun, "that is the gati. So I offer that gati in this iti in the evening; I offer this iti in that gati in the morning. These two will lead me to the place where all desires are. These two will overcome renewed death for me."

children.text: suhutam iti ha praśasyocur varān vṛṇīṣva yān adāmeti ||
children.translated_text: After praising it, saying, "It has been well offered," they said, "Choose the boons that we have offered."

children.text: sa hovācaiṣa eva me varo 'ham eva yuṣmabhyaṃ pṛthak pañca sahasrāṇi śatāśvāni dadānīti ||
children.translated_text: He said, "This alone is my boon: I myself will give each of you five thousand horses worth a hundred each."

children.text: etāni vā agnihotra upāsanāny ete kāmāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These, indeed, are the contemplative services of the agnihotra; these are the desires.

children.text: etān eva kāmān avarunddhe ya evaṃ vedātho yasyaivaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoti ||
children.translated_text: He wins just these desires who knows thus, and also the one for whom, while knowing thus, he offers the agnihotra.

children.text: Chapter 11
sa tato raśmīn eva rathaṃ samāsthāya candramasaḥ salokatām abhiprayāti ||
children.translated_text: Then, mounting the rays themselves as a chariot, he goes toward sharing the world of the moon.

children.text: caturahaṃ juhoti ||
children.translated_text: He offers for four days.

children.text: ṣoḍaśāhutayaḥ sampadyante ||
children.translated_text: Sixteen oblations are completed.

children.text: ṣoḍaśakalaṃ vai brahma ||
children.translated_text: For <s>brahman</s> is sixteen-parted.

children.text: ṣoḍaśakalā devāḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods are sixteen-parted.

children.text: ṣoḍaśakalam idaṃ sakṛt sarvam ||
children.translated_text: This whole totality is sixteen-parted.

children.text: sa yad iha ripraṃ pāpaṃ karma karoty ekayaiva tataḥ kalayā ||
children.translated_text: Whatever foul, evil deed he does here, he does with only one part of that.

children.text: yathā suvarṇaḥ pravṛttas tapyamānaḥ suvarṇatām abhiniṣpadyata evam eva dviṣatsu bhrātṛvyeṣu malaṃ pāpmānaṃ pratyūhya svargaṃ lokam abhipraiti ||
children.translated_text: Just as gold that has been set forth, when heated, comes into the state of gold, so, having thrust impurity and evil upon hateful rivals, he goes to the heavenly world.

children.text: eṣa vai śaśo ya eṣo 'ntaś candramasi ||
children.translated_text: This indeed is the hare which is within the moon.

children.text: eṣa hīdaṃ sarvaṃ śāsti ||
children.translated_text: For this one rules all this.

children.text: eṣa vai yamo ya eṣo 'ntaś candramasi ||
children.translated_text: This indeed is <s>Yama</s>, who is within the moon.

children.text: eṣa hīdaṃ sarvaṃ yamayati ||
children.translated_text: For this one restrains all this.

children.text: eṣa vai mṛtyur yad yamo 'tsyann eva nāma ||
children.translated_text: This indeed is death, since <s>Yama</s> is, as it were, one who consumes.

children.text: tam eva tābhir āhutibhiḥ śamayitvorjaṃ lokānāṃ jayati yamaṃ devaṃ devānāṃ ||
children.translated_text: Having pacified him with those oblations, he wins the nourishment of the worlds and <s>Yama</s>, the god among the gods.

children.text: yamasya devasya sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ samabhyārohati ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoti ||
children.translated_text: He ascends to union with, and sharing the world of, the god <s>Yama</s>, who, knowing thus, offers the agnihotra.

children.text: Chapter 12
prajāpatir vāvedam agra āsīt ||
children.translated_text: In the beginning this was <s>Prajāpati</s> alone.

children.text: mano ha vai prajāpatir devatā ||
children.translated_text: Mind, indeed, is <s>Prajāpati</s> as deity.

children.text: so 'kāmayata bahuḥ syāṃ prajāyeya bhūmānaṃ gaccheyam iti ||
children.translated_text: He desired, "May I become many; may I be propagated; may I attain abundance."

children.text: sa śīrṣata eva mukhatas trivṛtaṃ stomam asṛjata gāyatrīṃ chando rathantaraṃ sāmāgniṃ devatāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ manuṣyam ajaṃ paśum ||
children.translated_text: From his head, from his mouth, he created the trivṛt stoma, the gāyatrī metre, the rathantara sāman, Agni as deity, the Brahmin as human being, and the goat as animal.

children.text: tasmād brāhmaṇo gāyatrīcchandā āgneyo devatayā ||
children.translated_text: Therefore the Brahmin has the gāyatrī as metre and Agni as deity.

children.text: tasmād u mukhaṃ prajānāṃ mukhāddhyenam asṛjata ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, too, he is the mouth of creatures, for he created him from his mouth.

children.text: so 'kāmayata praiva jāyeyeti ||
children.translated_text: He desired, "May I be propagated still further."

children.text: sa bāhubhyām evorasaḥ pañcadaśaṃ stomam asṛjata triṣṭubhaṃ chando bṛhat sāmendraṃ devatāṃ rājanyaṃ manuṣyam aśvaṃ paśum ||
children.translated_text: From his arms, from his chest, he created the fifteenfold stoma, the triṣṭubh metre, the bṛhat sāman, Indra as deity, the Rājanya as human being, and the horse as animal.

children.text: tasmād rājanyas triṣṭupchandā aindro devatayā ||
children.translated_text: Therefore the Rājanya has the triṣṭubh as metre and Indra as deity.

children.text: tasmād u bāhubhyāṃ vīryaṃ karoti bāhubhyāṃ hy enam uraso vīryād asṛjata ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, too, he acts with strength by means of the arms; for from the arms, from the strength of his chest, he created him.

children.text: so 'kāmayata praiva jāyeyeti ||
children.translated_text: He desired, "May I be propagated still further."

children.text: Chapter 13
sa udarād eva madhyataḥ saptadaśaṃ stomam asṛjata jagatīṃ chando vāmadevyaṃ sāma viśvān devān devatāṃ vaiśyaṃ manuṣyaṃ gāṃ paśum ||
children.translated_text: From his belly, from the middle, he created the seventeenfold stoma, the jagatī metre, the vāmadevya sāman, the All-gods as deity, the Vaiśya as human being, and the cow as animal.

children.text: tasmād vaiśyo jagatīcchandā vaiśvadevo devatayā ||
children.translated_text: Therefore the Vaiśya has the jagatī as metre and the All-gods as deity.

children.text: tasmād u prajaniṣṇur udarāddhy enaṃ prajananād asṛjata ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, too, he is reproductive, for from the belly, from the organ of generation, he created him.

children.text: so 'kāmayata praiva jāyeyeti ||
children.translated_text: He desired, "May I be propagated still further."

children.text: sa padbhyām eva pratiṣṭhāyā ekaviṃśaṃ stomam asṛjatānuṣṭubhaṃ chando yajñāyajñīyaṃ sāma na kāṃcana devatāṃ śūdraṃ manuṣyam aviṃ paśum ||
children.translated_text: From his feet, from his foundation, he created the twenty-onefold stoma, the anuṣṭubh metre, the yajñāyajñīya sāman, no particular deity, the Śūdra as human being, and the sheep as animal.

children.text: tasmācchūdro 'nuṣṭupchandā veśmapatidevaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore the Śūdra has the anuṣṭubh as metre and the lord of the house as deity.

children.text: tasmād u pādāvanejyenaiva jijīviṣati padbhyāṃ hy enaṃ pratiṣṭhāyā asṛjata ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, too, he wishes to live by washing feet, for from the feet, from the foundation, he created him.

children.text: etayā vai sṛṣṭyā prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata ||
children.translated_text: With this very creation <s>Prajāpati</s> created creatures.

children.text: sa ya etad evaṃ veda bhūmānam eva prajayā paśubhir gacchati ||
children.translated_text: He who knows this thus attains abundance itself, with offspring and cattle.

children.text: tasmādvetaṃ yajñaṃ bhūyiṣṭhaṃ praśaṃsanti yad agniṣṭomaṃ prajāpatiyajño hy eṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore they praise this sacrifice most highly, namely the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, for this is <s>Prajāpati</s>'s sacrifice.

children.text: Chapter 14
prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata ||
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> created creatures.

children.text: so 'gnim api mukhād asisṛkṣata ||
children.translated_text: He also wished to emit <s>Agni</s> from his mouth.

children.text: so 'gnir mukhād bībhatsamāna ūrdhva uddrutya mastiṣkam uddihyāsṛjyata ||
children.translated_text: That <s>Agni</s>, recoiling from the mouth, sprang upward, pierced through the skull, and was created.

children.text: taṃ devāś carṣayaś copasametyābruvan vitunno 'yaṃ mastiṣko māmuyā bhūt karavāmemaṃ kasyāṃ citācitīti ||
children.translated_text: The gods and seers came up to him and said, 'This skull has been split; let it not become wasted. Let us make this into something, somehow or other.'

children.text: te bṛhaspatim abruvan somam asmin gṛhāṇeti ||
children.translated_text: They said to <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, 'Receive the <s>Soma</s> in this.'

children.text: sa bṛhaspatir abravīt sa vā ayaṃ krūra ivāpūto 'medhyo 'śṛtaṃkṛta iti ||
children.translated_text: Then <s>Bṛhaspati</s> said, 'This thing is, as it were, harsh, unpurified, unfit for sacrifice, and not made cooked.'

children.text: vayaṃ ta etaṃ pūtaṃ medhyaṃ śṛtaṃkṛtaṃ kurma ityabruvan ||
children.translated_text: They said, 'We shall make this purified, fit for sacrifice, and made cooked for you.'

children.text: taṃ vai ma āharateti ||
children.translated_text: 'Bring it to me, then,' he said.

children.text: tatheti ||
children.translated_text: 'So be it,' they said.

children.text: tam asmai prāyacchan ||
children.translated_text: They presented it to him.

children.text: taṃ pratyagṛhṇād devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ pratigṛhṇāmīti ||
children.translated_text: He received it, saying, 'At the impulse of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, with the arms of the <s>Aśvins</s>, with the hands of <s>Pūṣan</s>, I receive you.'

children.text: devāṅgair vāvainaṃ tat pratyagṛhṇāt ||
children.translated_text: In that way he received it with the limbs of the gods.

children.text: taṃ pratigṛhyāpavayad vasavas tvā punantu gāyatreṇa chandasā suprajāvaniṃ rāyaspoṣavaniṃ rudrās tvā punantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā suprajāvaniṃ rāyaspoṣavanim ādityās tvā punantu jāgatena chandasā suprajāvaniṃ rāyaspoṣavanim iti ||
children.translated_text: Having received it, he purified it, saying, 'May the <s>Vasus</s> purify you with the Gāyatrī meter, winning good offspring, winning increase of wealth. May the <s>Rudras</s> purify you with the Triṣṭubh meter, winning good offspring, winning increase of wealth. May the <s>Ādityas</s> purify you with the Jagatī meter, winning good offspring, winning increase of wealth.'

children.text: chandobhiś ca vāvainaṃ tad devatābhiś cāpavayat ||
children.translated_text: Thus he purified it with the meters and with the deities.

children.text: taṃ pavayitvā paścād akṣaṃ sādayati bārhaspatyam asi vānaspatyaṃ prajāpater mūrdhātyāyupātram iti ||
children.translated_text: Having purified it, he sets it down behind the axle, saying, 'You are <s>Bārhaspatya</s>; you are wooden; you are <s>Prajāpati</s>'s head; you are the atyāyupātra.'

children.text: yad āha bārhaspatyam asīti bṛhaspatir hy etam agre pratyagṛhṇāt ||
children.translated_text: When he says, 'You are <s>Bārhaspatya</s>,' it is because <s>Bṛhaspati</s> received it first.

children.text: yad āha vānaspatyam iti vanaspatibhyo hy enam adhikurvanti ||
children.translated_text: When he says, 'You are wooden,' it is because they assign it to the forest trees.

children.text: yad āha prajāpater mūrdheti prajāpater hy eṣa mūrdhāsīt ||
children.translated_text: When he says, 'You are <s>Prajāpati</s>'s head,' it is because this was <s>Prajāpati</s>'s head.

children.text: yad āha atyāyupātram ity ati hy etad anyāni pātrāṇi pātraṃ ||
children.translated_text: When he says, 'You are the atyāyupātra,' it is because this vessel goes beyond the other vessels.

children.text: yad v eva pātraṃ prathamaṃ yujyata uttamaṃ vimucyate tenaivāty anyāni pātrāṇi ||
children.translated_text: Or rather, because a vessel is first yoked and last unyoked, by that it goes beyond the other vessels.

children.text: pra śreyasaḥ pātram āpnoti ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: He who knows thus obtains a vessel of higher good fortune.

children.text: taṃ paścād akṣaṃ sādayitvā gāyatraṃ viśvarūpāsu gāyati ||
children.translated_text: Having set it down behind the axle, he sings the Gāyatra chant on the Viśvarūpā verses.

children.text: Chapter 15
sa yat prathamam apāhan sā kṛṣṇāvirabhavat ||
children.translated_text: What he struck away first became black sheep's wool.

children.text: yad dvitīyam apāhan sā dhūmrāvirabhavat ||
children.translated_text: What he struck away second became smoky-colored sheep's wool.

children.text: yat tṛtīyam apāhan sā phalguny avirabhavat ||
children.translated_text: What he struck away third became reddish sheep's wool.

children.text: sa yaṃ kāmayeta pāpīyān syād iti kṛṣṇam asya pavitre 'pyasyet pāpīyān eva bhavati ||
children.translated_text: If he should desire of someone, 'May he become worse,' he should place black wool in his purifier; he indeed becomes worse.

children.text: atha yaṃ kāmayeta nārvāṅ na paras syād iti dhūmram asya pavitre 'pyasyen naivārvāṅ na paro bhavati ||
children.translated_text: But if he should desire of someone, 'May he be neither lower nor beyond,' he should place smoky wool in his purifier; he becomes neither lower nor beyond.

children.text: atha yaṃ kāmayeta śreyān syād rucam aśnuvīteti phalgunam asya pavitraṃ kuryācchreyān eva bhavati rucam aśnute ||
children.translated_text: But if he should desire of someone, 'May he become better; may he obtain radiance,' he should make his purifier of reddish wool; he indeed becomes better and obtains radiance.

children.text: asti hi tatrāpy ādityasya nyaktaṃ ||
children.translated_text: For there too there is a hidden mark of the sun.

children.text: tad antareṣe avahṛtya sammārṣṭi vasavas tvā sammṛjantu gāyatreṇa chandasā rudrās tvā saṃmṛjantu traiṣṭubhena chandasādityās tvā saṃmṛjantu jāgatena chandaseti ||
children.translated_text: Having taken that down between the two shafts, he wipes it, saying, 'May the <s>Vasus</s> wipe you with the Gāyatrī meter; may the <s>Rudras</s> wipe you with the Triṣṭubh meter; may the <s>Ādityas</s> wipe you with the Jagatī meter.'

children.text: tad udīcīnadaśaṃ pavitravatyā vitanoti pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇas pata iti samaṣṭyai ||
children.translated_text: He stretches it out with its fringes turned northward, using the verse with 'purifier': 'Your purifier has been stretched out, O lord of prayer,' for completeness.

children.text: tapoṣ pavitraṃ vitataṃ divas pada iti svargakāmasya ||
children.translated_text: 'The purifier of fervor has been stretched out from the place of heaven,' for one desiring heaven.

children.text: arūrucad uṣasaḥ pṛśnir agrayur iti prajākāmasya ||
children.translated_text: 'The speckled one, going foremost, has shone from the dawns,' for one desiring offspring.

children.text: sarvābhir eva vitanuyād eteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ kāmānām upāptyai ||
children.translated_text: He should stretch it out with all of them, for the attainment of all these desires.

children.text: rājānam ānayati ||
children.translated_text: He brings in the king.

children.text: tam abhimantrayate sa pavasva sudhāmā devānām abhi priyāṇi dhāma trir devebhyo 'pavathās trir ādityebhyas trir aṅgirobhyo yena turyeṇa brahmaṇā bṛhaspataye 'pavathās tena mahyaṃ pavasva ||
children.translated_text: He addresses him with the mantra: 'Flow pure, you of good abode, toward the dear abodes of the gods. Three times you have purified yourself for the gods, three times for the <s>Ādityas</s>, three times for the <s>Aṅgirases</s>. With that fourth sacred formulation with which you purified yourself for <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, with that flow pure for me.'

children.text: sa naḥ pavasva śaṃ gave śaṃ janāya śam arvate ||
children.translated_text: 'Flow pure for us, for blessing to the cow, blessing to the people, blessing to the horse.

children.text: śaṃ rājann oṣadhībhya iti ||
children.translated_text: Blessing, O king, to the plants.'

children.text: śam evodgātre bhavati śaṃ yajamānāya śaṃ prajābhyaḥ ||
children.translated_text: There is blessing indeed for the <s>udgātṛ</s>, blessing for the sacrificer, and blessing for the offspring.

children.text: adhvaryur āgrayaṇaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇan hiṃkaroti ||
children.translated_text: The <s>adhvaryu</s>, while taking the Āgrayaṇa cup, utters the hiṃ-call.

children.text: tad eva hiṃkṛtaṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: That thereby becomes uttered with the hiṃ-call.

children.text: athodgātaikarce gāyatraṃ gāyaty uccā te jātam andhaseti ||
children.translated_text: Then the <s>udgātṛ</s> sings the Gāyatra chant on a single verse, 'High was your juice born.'

children.text: sa ud ity eveto devebhyo havyaṃ vahati ||
children.translated_text: Thus, with 'up,' he carries the oblation from here upward to the gods.

children.text: divi sad bhūmy ā dada ity amuto vṛṣṭim ācyāvayati ||
children.translated_text: With 'sitting in heaven, taking from the earth,' he makes rain descend from there.

children.text: tāvimau lokau savāsinau karoti ||
children.translated_text: He makes these two worlds possessed of a common dwelling.

children.text: tāvasmai kāmaṃ pinvāte ||
children.translated_text: They swell desire for him.

children.text: kāmam asmā imau lokau pinvāte ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: These two worlds swell desire for him who knows thus.

children.text: Chapter 16
prāṇān vāvaitat saṃtatya svargaṃ lokaṃ sarpanti yad antar havirdhāne grahān gṛhītvā bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpanti ||
children.translated_text: When, having taken the cups inside the two havirdhāna sheds, they creep forth to the bahiṣpavamāna, they extend the vital breaths and creep to the heavenly world.

children.text: saṃtatāḥ sarpanti ||
children.translated_text: They creep in continuity.

children.text: saṃtata iva vai svargo lokaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For the heavenly world is, as it were, continuous.

children.text: svargasyaiva lokasya saṃtatyā avyavacchedāya ||
children.translated_text: This is for the continuity and non-interruption of the heavenly world.

children.text: prāvabhrā iva sarpanti ||
children.translated_text: They creep as if leaning forward.

children.text: pratikūla iva vā itas svargo lokaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For from here the heavenly world is, as it were, against the current.

children.text: tad yathā vā adaḥ pratikūlam udyan prāvabhra iva bhavatyevam evaitat ||
children.translated_text: Just as, when one goes up against a current, one is as if leaning forward, so indeed is this.

children.text: svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyā anapavyāthāya ||
children.translated_text: For the complete attainment of the heavenly world, and for freedom from disturbance.

children.text: adhvaryuḥ prathamaḥ sarpati prāṇo yajñasya ||
children.translated_text: The adhvaryu creeps first: he is the breath of the sacrifice.

children.text: tasmād yad avacchidyeran prāṇād avacchidyeran pramāyukāḥ syuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, if they were cut off, they would be cut off from breath; they would be short-lived.

children.text: prastotā dvitīyaḥ sarpati mukhaṃ sāmnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The prastotar creeps second: he is the mouth of the sāman.

children.text: tasmād yad avacchidyeran mukhyām ārtim ārcheyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, if they were cut off, they would incur an affliction affecting the mouth.

children.text: udgātā tṛtīyaḥ sarpati sarvadevatyaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The udgātṛ creeps third: <s>Prajāpati</s>, belonging to all the gods.

children.text: tasmād yad avacchidyeran sarvajyāniṃ jīyeran ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, if they were cut off, they would lose everything.

children.text: pratihartā caturthaḥ sarpati turīyaṃ sāmnaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The pratihartṛ creeps fourth: he is the fourth part of the sāman.

children.text: tasmād yad avacchidyeraṃs turīyeṇātmano yātayeyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, if they were cut off, they would torment themselves with the fourth part.

children.text: yajamānaḥ pañcamaḥ sarpati ||
children.translated_text: The sacrificer creeps fifth.

children.text: pāṅkto yajñaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The sacrifice is fivefold.

children.text: pāṅktāḥ paśavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The animals are fivefold.

children.text: tasmād yad avacchidyeran yajñāt paśubhyo 'vacchidyeran ||
children.translated_text: Therefore, if they were cut off, they would be cut off from the sacrifice and from the animals.

children.text: Chapter 17
ādityo vā etad atrāgra āsīd yatraitaccātvālam ||
children.translated_text: The sun, indeed, was here in the beginning, at the place where this cātvāla pit is.

children.text: ado 'gniḥ ||
children.translated_text: That there was Agni.

children.text: sa idaṃ sarvaṃ prātapat ||
children.translated_text: He scorched all this.

children.text: tasya devāḥ pradāhād abibhayuḥ ||
children.translated_text: The gods feared his burning.

children.text: te 'bruvan sarvaṃ vā ayam idaṃ pradhakṣyati vīmau pariharāmeti ||
children.translated_text: They said, "This one will burn up all this. Come, let us remove these two around him."

children.text: tam atas tisṛbhir ādadata tisṛbhir antarikṣāt tisṛbhir divam agamayan ||
children.translated_text: They took him from here with three verses, from the midspace with three, and with three they made him go to heaven.

children.text: sa tataḥ parāṅ evātapat ||
children.translated_text: From there he shone facing away.

children.text: ta etad āvad uttamam akṣaram apaśyan ||
children.translated_text: They saw this final syllable, up to that point.

children.text: tenainam arvāñcam akurvan ||
children.translated_text: With it they made him face hither.

children.text: tata etad arvāṅ tapati ||
children.translated_text: From then on he shines hitherward.

children.text: eteno evāvatākṣareṇāgnim asmin loke 'dadhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: With this very syllable, extending up to that point, they placed Agni in this world.

children.text: sa yaṃ kāmayeta yajamānaḥ svargalokaḥ syād iti cātvālam evainam avakhyāpyodgāyet ||
children.translated_text: If the sacrificer should desire, "May he become one whose world is heaven," he should make him look down into the cātvāla pit and then sing the udgītha.

children.text: tam atas tisṛbhir evādadate tisṛbhir antarikṣāt tisṛbhir divaṃ gamayanti ||
children.translated_text: They take him from here with three verses, from the midspace with three, and with three they make him go to heaven.

children.text: svargaloko yajamāno bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The sacrificer becomes one whose world is heaven.

children.text: īśvaro ha tu pramāyuko bhavitoḥ ||
children.translated_text: But he is liable to become short-lived.

children.text: parācīṣu hi stuvanti ||
children.translated_text: For they praise with verses turned away.

children.text: sa yadaiva sarvābhiḥ stuyur athottamām agre brūyād athāvarām athāvarām ||
children.translated_text: When they are about to praise with all of them, he should recite the last one first, then the lower one, then the lower one.

children.text: tāḥ sarvā arvācīḥ ||
children.translated_text: All those are turned hitherward.

children.text: tad u vā āhuḥ satraitat pratyavarūḍhaṃ svargakāmyā vai yajata iti ||
children.translated_text: Now they also say, "Surely this is properly descended; for they sacrifice desiring heaven."

children.text: yad evāda āvad uttamam akṣaraṃ bhavati tenāsmāl lokān nāvacchidyate ||
children.translated_text: Because that final syllable extends up to that point, by it he is not cut off from this world.

children.text: Chapter 18
prajāpatiṃ kalpayitvodgāyet ||
children.translated_text: He should sing the udgītha after arranging <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: yo ha vai prajāpatiṃ kalpayitvodgāyati kalpate 'smai ||
children.translated_text: For whoever sings the udgītha after arranging <s>Prajāpati</s>, it is arranged for him.

children.text: diśaḥ pradiśa ādiśo vidiśa uddiśo diśa iti ||
children.translated_text: "The quarters, the intermediate quarters, the designated quarters, the cross-quarters, the upward quarters, the quarters".

children.text: diśo vai prajāpatiḥ ||
children.translated_text: The quarters, indeed, are <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: prajāpatim eva tat kalpayitvodgāyati ||
children.translated_text: Thus he sings the udgītha after arranging <s>Prajāpati</s> himself.

children.text: kalpate 'smai ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: It is arranged for him who knows thus.

children.text: kapivano ha smāha bhauvāyanaḥ kiṃ te yajñaṃ gacchanti ye devasomasyābhakṣayitvā pra vā sarpanti pra vā dhāvayantīti ||
children.translated_text: <s>Kapivana Bhauvāyana</s> used to say, "What sacrifice do those attain who, without tasting the devasoma, either creep forth or make it run forward?"

children.text: bahiṣpavamānam upasanneṣu brūyād yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śucim iva manyetāhara hastam iti ||
children.translated_text: When they have approached the bahiṣpavamāna, he should say to a brahman whom he considers pure, "Bring your hand."

children.text: tena samupahūyāthānumantrayeta yo devānām iha somapītho 'smin yajñe barhiṣi vedyāṃ tasyedaṃ bhakṣayāmasīti ||
children.translated_text: Having summoned him with it, he should then address him with the formula: "Whatever soma-drinking of the gods is here in this sacrifice, on the barhis, on the altar, of that we partake."

children.text: yadi ca ha pradhāvayati yadi ca nātha hāsya bhakṣita eva devasomo bhavati ||
children.translated_text: And if he does make it run forward, or if he does not, then his devasoma has indeed been tasted.

children.text: etadāyatanā vā āraṇyāḥ paśavo ||
children.translated_text: Forest animals, indeed, have this as their abode.

children.text: yad bahiṣpavamānam araṇye stuvanti tasmād āraṇyāḥ paśavo 'raṇyaṃ sacante ||
children.translated_text: Because they praise the bahiṣpavamāna in the forest, therefore forest animals cling to the forest.

children.text: parācīṣu stuvanti ||
children.translated_text: They praise with verses turned away.

children.text: tasmād āraṇyāḥ paśavo 'raṇyād evāraṇyam abhiprerata ||
children.translated_text: Therefore forest animals are driven from one forest to another forest.

children.text: ekarūpāsu stuvanti ||
children.translated_text: They praise with verses of one form.

children.text: tasmād āraṇyāḥ paśava ekarūpā ||
children.translated_text: Therefore forest animals are of one form.

children.text: āvad uttamam akṣaraṃ bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The final syllable extends up to that point.

children.text: tasmād ekaiko 'nyo 'calo grāme 'dhigamyate ||
children.translated_text: Therefore one single other unmoving animal is found in the village.

children.text: atho araṇye hataṃ grāmam abhyavaharanti ||
children.translated_text: And then they carry into the village what has been killed in the forest.

children.text: stutvoddravanti ||
children.translated_text: After praising, they run upward.

children.text: yajamānam eva tat svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti ||
children.translated_text: By that they make the sacrificer go to the heavenly world.

children.text: bāhūn udgṛhṇanti ||
children.translated_text: They raise their arms.

children.text: yajamānam eva tat svarge loke samādadhati ||
children.translated_text: By that they set the sacrificer in the heavenly world.

children.text: te vai tad anṛtaṃ kurvanti ye martyaṃ santam amṛtatvaṃ gamayanti ||
children.translated_text: They do something untrue, those who make a mortal, while he is mortal, go to immortality.

children.text: te rūpeṇa varcasā vyṛdhyante ||
children.translated_text: They are deprived of beauty and brilliance.

children.text: sa ya etad evānya uttiṣṭhet tam uttiṣṭhantam ārabhyānūttiṣṭhen ||
children.translated_text: If another man were to rise up at just that moment, one should take hold of him as he rises and rise up after him.

children.text: na rūpeṇa varcasā vyṛdhyate nārtim ārcchati ||
children.translated_text: He is not deprived of beauty or brilliance, and he does not incur affliction.

children.text: bhaviṣyad vijānīyāt ||
children.translated_text: He should know what is going to happen.

children.text: yady etāḥ prajā dodruvā iva syur dodruvo yogakṣemo bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: If these creatures are as if running restlessly, welfare and security will be restless.

children.text: tathāyam udgātodagāsīd iti vidyāt ||
children.translated_text: He should know, "In that way this udgātṛ has sung the udgītha."

children.text: yady u śāntā iva syuś śānto yogakṣemo bhaviṣyati ||
children.translated_text: But if they are as if calm, welfare and security will be calm.

children.text: tathāyam udgātodagāsīd iti vidyāt ||
children.translated_text: He should know, "In that way this udgātṛ has sung the udgītha."

children.text: eṣo ha vijñā ||
children.translated_text: This, indeed, is the sign.

children.text: Chapter 19
te ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Those are the six seasons.

children.text: ṣaḍḍhura etā devatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: These deities are the six yoke-bearers.

children.text: etābhis tad devā asurān adhūrvan ||
children.translated_text: With these the gods injured the asuras.

children.text: yad adhūrvaṃs tasmāddhuro 'bhavan ||
children.translated_text: Because they injured them, therefore they became yoke-bearers.

children.text: etābhir asya sarvābhir devatābhiḥ stutaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: For one who knows thus, the chant has been sung with all these deities.

children.text: etābhya u eva sa sarvābhyo devatābhya āvṛścyate ya evaṃ vidvāṃsam upavadati ||
children.translated_text: From all these deities he is cut off who reviles one who knows thus.

children.text: tāṃ haitām eke paṅktiṃ vigāyanti nāvikṛtā garbhā jāyanta iti vadantaḥ sāṃjagmāno dāyivā kovā pavasvā sūryā iti ||
children.translated_text: Some sing this paṅkti in a modified way, saying, "Unaltered embryos are born": "sāṃjagmāno dāyivā kovā pavasvā sūryā."

children.text: tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanir yata etāṃ vigāyanti tata idaṃ garbhā muhyanti ||
children.translated_text: On this <s>Śāṭyāyani</s> said, "Because they sing this in a modified way, therefore embryos here become confused."

children.text: yato vai garbhāḥ prasāryante 'tha jāyante ||
children.translated_text: For when embryos are stretched out, then they are born.

children.text: tasmād eṣā gāyatram eva prasṛtā geyeti ||
children.translated_text: Therefore this is to be sung as a gāyatra that is stretched out.

children.text: tad āhuḥ sa vā adya dhuro vigāyed ya enāḥ saṃgātuṃ vidyād iti ||
children.translated_text: They say, 'Today he would indeed sing out of tune from the reins, if he knew how to sing these together.'

children.text: taddhaika āhur bahiṣpavamāne vāva vayaṃ vigāyantaḥ saṃgāyāmo yad o vā iti vāṅnidhanāḥ kurmaḥ ||
children.translated_text: Some say, 'It is in the bahiṣpavamāna that, while singing out of tune, we sing together, when we make them have vā or o as their nidhana ending.'

children.text: tenaiva naḥ saṃgītā bhavantīti ||
children.translated_text: By that very means they become sung together for us.'

children.text: tenājyeṣv ādriyante na pavamānayoḥ ||
children.translated_text: Therefore they take care over this in the ājya chants, not in the pavamāna chants.

children.text: atha haika āhur ājyeṣv eva vayaṃ vigāyantaḥ saṃgāyāma iti ||
children.translated_text: But some say, 'It is precisely in the ājya chants that we, while singing out of tune, sing together.'

children.text: jagatīṃ hotur ājye ||
children.translated_text: A jagatī is used in the Hotṛ's ājya chant.

children.text: jāgato hi hotā ||
children.translated_text: For the Hotṛ belongs to the jagatī metre.

children.text: Chapter 20
yadi dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyeta taṃ dagdhvāsthāny upanahyāpabhajya somaṃ yo 'sya nediṣṭhatamaḥ syāt tena saha dīkṣayitvā yājayeyuḥ ||
children.translated_text: If one of the consecrated sacrificers should die, then, after burning him, tying up his bones, and setting aside the Soma, they should consecrate together with the one who is nearest to him and have him perform the sacrifice.

children.text: samānāya vā ete yajñāya samānāya sukṛtāya samārabhya dīkṣante ||
children.translated_text: For they have undertaken the same sacrifice and the same meritorious work, and are consecrated for it.

children.text: tenaivainaṃ niravadayante ||
children.translated_text: By that very means they settle him without loss.

children.text: etad anyat kuryuḥ ||
children.translated_text: They should do this further thing.

children.text: abhiṣutya somam anyad agṛhītvā grahān yā dakṣiṇāḥ sraktīs tad asthāni nidhāya mārjālīye stuvīran ||
children.translated_text: After pressing the Soma, before taking the other grahas, they should place his bones on the southern corners, where the dakṣiṇās are, and sing praise in the mārjālīya.

children.text: arbudasyargbhiḥ stuvate ||
children.translated_text: They sing praise with the verses of <s>Arbuda</s>.

children.text: arbudo vai sarpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: <s>Arbuda</s> is a serpent.

children.text: etābhir mṛtāṃ tvacam apāhata ||
children.translated_text: With these he cast off the dead skin.

children.text: mriyanta iva vā ete ye mṛtāya kurvantīti ||
children.translated_text: For those who perform rites for a dead man are, as it were, dying.

children.text: mṛtām evaitābhis tvacam apaghnate ||
children.translated_text: With these very verses they cast off the dead skin.

children.text: tisṛṣu stuvanti ||
children.translated_text: They sing praise on three verses.

children.text: tṛtīyo vā itaḥ pitṛlokaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For the third world from here is the world of the Fathers.

children.text: pitṛlokam evainaṃ gamayanti ||
children.translated_text: They thereby make him go to the world of the Fathers.

children.text: parācīṣu stuvanti ||
children.translated_text: They sing praise on verses turned away.

children.text: parāñcam evainaṃ tad amuṃ lokaṃ gamayanti ||
children.translated_text: Thereby they make him go turned away to that world yonder.

children.text: yāmaṃ sāma bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The sāman is a Yama chant.

children.text: yamalokam evainaṃ gamayanti ||
children.translated_text: They thereby make him go to the world of <s>Yama</s>.

children.text: aprastutam apratihṛtaṃ sāma bhavati ||
children.translated_text: The sāman is without a prastāva and without a pratihāra.

children.text: prastāvapratihārābhyāṃ vai yajamāno dhṛtaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For the sacrificer is held by the prastāva and the pratihāra.

children.text: tad yad aprastutam apratihṛtaṃ sāma bhavaty amuṣminn evainaṃ tal loke pratiṣṭhāpayanti ||
children.translated_text: Since the sāman is without a prastāva and without a pratihāra, they thereby establish him in that world yonder itself.

children.text: stutam anuśaṃsanty etā ṛco 'nubruvanto dakṣiṇān ūrūn upāghnānāḥ ||
children.translated_text: After the praise has been sung they recite these verses, striking their right thighs.

children.text: trir apasalī mārjālīyaṃ paryāyanti ||
children.translated_text: Three times, moving counterclockwise, they go around the mārjālīya.

children.text: amuṣminn evainaṃ tal loke nidhuvate ||
children.translated_text: Thereby they shake him down in that world yonder itself.

children.text: abhy enam amuṣmin loke vāyuḥ pavate ||
children.translated_text: In that world the wind blows around him.

children.text: tad āhur yanti vā ete patho ye mṛtāya kurvantīti ||
children.translated_text: They say, 'Those who perform rites for a dead man indeed go from the path.'

children.text: Chapter 21
sa trivṛd rathantarasāmā bhavati ||
children.translated_text: It is a trivṛt chant with the rathantara-sāman.

children.text: brahma vai trivṛd brahma rathantaram ||
children.translated_text: The trivṛt is <s>brahman</s>; the rathantara is <s>brahman</s>.

children.text: brahmaṇā vāva sa tad brahmavarcasam ārdhnot ||
children.translated_text: With <s>brahman</s> he thereby attained brahmanical radiance.

children.text: brahmaṇaiva brahmavarcasam ṛdhnoti ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: With <s>brahman</s> one attains brahmanical radiance, who knows thus.

children.text: tasya trayastriṃśad dakṣiṇā bhavanti ||
children.translated_text: For this rite there are thirty-three dakṣiṇās.

children.text: trayastriṃśad vai devatāḥ ||
children.translated_text: There are thirty-three deities.

children.text: devatānām eva purodhām āśnuta ||
children.translated_text: He thereby obtains precedence among the deities.

children.text: aśvaś catustriṃśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: The horse is the thirty-fourth.

children.text: prajāpater vā etad rūpaṃ yad aśvaḥ ||
children.translated_text: For the horse is this form of <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: saprajāpatikānām eva tena devatānāṃ purodhām āśnuta ||
children.translated_text: By that he obtains precedence among the deities together with <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: tasyaitā yathāpūrvam anusavanaṃ dakṣiṇā dadāty aṣṭau prātassavane dadāty ekādaśa mādhyaṃdine savane dvādaśa tṛtīyasavane 'nūbaṃdhyāyām ekām ||
children.translated_text: He gives these dakṣiṇās at each pressing in the former order: eight at the morning pressing, eleven at the midday pressing, twelve at the third pressing, one at the anūbandhyā,

children.text: udavasānīyāyām ekām ||
children.translated_text: and one at the udavasānīyā.

children.text: anusavanam aśvaṃ tṛtīyaśaḥ ||
children.translated_text: At each pressing he gives a third part of the horse.

children.text: tad yā aṣṭau prātassavane dadāty aṣṭau vasavo vasūnām eva purodhām āśnuta ||
children.translated_text: The eight that he gives at the morning pressing are the eight Vasus; he thereby obtains precedence among the Vasus.

children.text: atha yā ekādaśa mādhyaṃdine savana ekādaśa rudrā rudrāṇām eva tena purodhām āśnuta ||
children.translated_text: Then the eleven at the midday pressing are the eleven Rudras; by that he obtains precedence among the Rudras.

children.text: atha yā dvādaśa tṛtīyasavane dvādaśādityā ādityānām eva tena purodhām āśnuta ||
children.translated_text: Then the twelve at the third pressing are the twelve Ādityas; by that he obtains precedence among the Ādityas.

children.text: atha yām anūbaṃdhyāyām ekāṃ mitrāvaruṇayor eva tena purodhām āśnuta ||
children.translated_text: Then the one at the anūbandhyā is for <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>; by that he obtains precedence among them.

children.text: atha yām udavasānīyāyām ekāṃ karma karma me dakṣiṇāvad asad iti ||
children.translated_text: Then the one at the udavasānīyā means, 'May my rite be possessed of dakṣiṇā.'

children.text: atha yam anusavanam aśvaṃ tṛtīyaśaḥ prajāpater eva tena purodhām āśnuta ||
children.translated_text: Then, as for the third part of the horse at each pressing, by that he obtains precedence with <s>Prajāpati</s> himself.

children.text: Chapter 22
tad yathā vṛkṣaṃ vā giriṃ vādhiruhya vyavekṣetaivam evaitasmāllokād anyān lokān vyavekṣate ||
children.translated_text: As one might climb a tree or a mountain and look out in different directions, just so from this world he looks out upon the other worlds.

children.text: sa imāḥ prajā aśanāyantīḥ pratyavaikṣata ||
children.translated_text: He looked down upon these creatures as they were hungry.

children.text: tā dvābhyāṃ rūpābhyāṃ pratyādravan nīlena ca suvarṇena ca ||
children.translated_text: They ran toward him in two forms, dark-blue and golden.

children.text: tad yat parjanyasya varṣiṣyataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tannīlam ||
children.translated_text: The blackness of a raincloud about to rain is the dark-blue.

children.text: atha yad apsv antar vidyotate tat suvarṇam ||
children.translated_text: And what flashes within the waters is the golden.

children.text: tābhyo 'varṣat ||
children.translated_text: He rained upon them.

children.text: tata odano 'jāyata ||
children.translated_text: From that odana, cooked rice, was born.

children.text: tam aśitvodānan ||
children.translated_text: Having eaten it, they breathed upward.

children.text: sa udano 'bhavat ||
children.translated_text: It became udana, upward breath.

children.text: tad udanasyodanatvam ||
children.translated_text: That is the odana-ness of odana.

children.text: udano ha vai nāmaiṣa ||
children.translated_text: This is indeed named udana.

children.text: tam odana iti parokṣam ācakṣate ||
children.translated_text: They call it odana in an indirect way.

children.text: dvitīyaṃ jyāyo 'nnādyam ajāyata ||
children.translated_text: A second, greater form of food was born.

children.text: tad abhisaṃpadya vyamathnata ||
children.translated_text: Having come together with it, they churned it apart.

children.text: sa mantho 'bhavat ||
children.translated_text: It became mantha, a mixed drink.

children.text: tan manthasya manthatvam ||
children.translated_text: That is the mantha-ness of mantha.

children.text: tad etad dvayam evānnādyasya rūpaṃ yaccaivāśnāti yacca pibati ||
children.translated_text: This twofold form alone belongs to food: what one eats and what one drinks.

children.text: yad aśnāty odanasya tad rūpaṃ yat pibati manthasya tat ||
children.translated_text: What one eats is the form of odana; what one drinks is the form of mantha.

children.text: ubhayaṃ hāsyaitad gṛhe 'dhigamyate ya evaṃ veda ||
children.translated_text: Both of these are obtained in the house of one who knows thus.

children.text: tau haitau prajāpater eva stanau yad vrīhiś ca yavaś ca ||
children.translated_text: These two, rice and barley, are indeed the two breasts of <s>Prajāpati</s>.

children.text: tābhyām imāḥ prajā bibharti ||
children.translated_text: With them he sustains these creatures.
